about.description1: With over 10 years of experience, I help individuals and professionals create meaningful transformations in their lives. Using scientific methods and an empathetic approach, I accompany each client on their unique journey.

You live what you feel, observing people in front of you only through thought, I am a spiritual guide and behavioral sciences expert who has achieved amazing things with countless clients and can help bring positive change to their lives.
about.story4: One of the most important reasons I chose this profession is the shaping of consciousness at a young age and its effect on our entire life. My goal is to ensure our consciousness is formed healthily and with love, to help our children continue their lives as much happier individuals.

novaVera.tagline: Don't try to change your life. Redesign it.
intro: From the outside, many things in your life may seem fine. But you know that somewhere, the same cycles keep repeating.

You start but can't sustain. You decide but slip back into old habits. You find yourself living similar stories in your relationships. You want to take better care of yourself, yet in daily life you keep putting yourself last.
And after a while, you ask yourself:
novaVera.introAnswer: Nova Vera Method® was born exactly from this question. Because sometimes it is not you that needs to change; it is the system you live in.
what: Nova Vera Method® is a personalized transformation methodology that brings together psychology, behavioral sciences and holistic life design.

Here, your life is never viewed from a single point. Your relationships affect your mood, your mood affects your behavior, your behavior affects your body, your body affects your energy, and your daily habits affect your performance. Your relationship with money, your boundaries, your environment, the space you give yourself, your life purpose and your recurring patterns are all parts of the same whole.
That is why, in Nova Vera, the question is not only “What is going wrong in your life?” The real question is:
novaVera.whatQuestion: “What is the system that creates your current life, and how should it be redesigned for the life you want?”
novaVera.journeyTitle: Everyone's Nova Vera Journey Is Different
journey: There are no ready-made recipes here. In the first stage, the current map of your life is drawn: your thought and behavior patterns, daily habits, relationships, life structure, goals, performance, strengths and areas open to growth are evaluated together.
Then a personal Nova Vera Life Design Map is created for you. Because a system that works in someone else's life may not be the right system for yours.
novaVera.journeyHighlight: We don't fit you into a program. We design the program around you.
novaVera.includesIntro: Nova Vera is not just a talk-based development program. The process starts with awareness and is built on understanding, designing, applying, strengthening, integrating and making it sustainable. Depending on your needs, the process may bring together:
novaVera.includesNote: The goal is not to do dozens of exercises. The goal is to identify what truly needs to change in your life and transform it in the right order.
novaVera.outcomesTitle: What We Want You to Notice Over Time…
outcomes: A life structure where you no longer have to constantly force yourself
Recognizing habits that don't serve you and replacing them with new ones
Bringing to life what you have been postponing
Choosing where your time and energy go
A healthier relationship with your body
Becoming someone who stands behind their own decisions
novaVera.outcomesFinal: And most importantly: going from being a spectator of your life to being its designer.
novaVera.outcomesNote: Nova Vera does not promise you a flawless life. Nor does it promise you'll become someone else. Its purpose is to build, together, the life system that is sustainable for you.
novaVera.notSessionTitle: This Is Not a Session, It Is a Transformation Journey
notSession: Some changes don't happen in a few meetings. Transforming behaviors, habits and life structures formed over years takes time, practice and follow-up.
That is why, in Nova Vera, we don't just talk about “what you should do.” We apply it with you, follow up, readjust when needed, and support your new way of living until it settles.
The investment here is not only in the meetings you attend. It is an investment in yourself, your time, and the quality of the years ahead of you.
novaVera.whoIntro: It is designed for people who feel some things in their life need to change;
who: Tired of repeating the same cycles
Feeling they live below their potential
Wanting to rebuild a structure for themselves
Seeking a stronger balance in relationships, work or personal life
Wanting to build a lasting system instead of starting and quitting
Not willing to leave the next chapter of their life to chance
novaVera.whoNote: Nova Vera doesn't have to be right for everyone. Because this journey requires not only wanting change, but being ready to truly invest in your own life and take responsibility for the process.
novaVera.firstStepTitle: First Step: Nova Vera Life Design Analysis
firstStep: Every journey begins with understanding you. In the first meeting, we evaluate your current life system together, identify your needs and priorities, and explore whether Nova Vera is right for you.
If it is, your personal transformation journey and work plan are created.
Maybe what you need is not a new life. Maybe what you need is to redesign the life you have with a new consciousness.
novaVera.quote: A person transforms not by trying to change, but by changing the system they live in.
novaVera.ctaButton: Apply for a Life Design Analysis
